svg.text: Lookout: geographic terraces, doors and stair bays
Architecture defines circulation. Diagrams are explanatory overlays; no guidance strips are collision, roads or excavation.
Two hillside stair routes; four deliberately separated bays.
L06 shares L04. L11 shares L09. No diagonal extra stairs.
Short threshold steps raise the clearing 5.65 → building floors 6.
Buildings retain source-library rough props and complete floors.
Protected room holes stay saved; terrain uses geographic fields.
Sections show authored rises/runs and supported receiving landings.
One braced frame; repeated switchbacks; cab doors meet level floors.
L06 returns through the actual hut east door and shared L04 bay.
L11 uses the store south door, shared L09 bay and east return.
Cab south door: level west gallery. Cab east door: level deck.
Lines illustrate connectivity only; all physical surfaces are authored
terrain, floors, porches, stair treads, landings and supports.
Native candidate drawings; runtime renderer / navigation / rooms / portals / acoustics / spawns / services remain unaccepted.
